overheads.min_launch_floor_source: 950PR_9579 add tiny-shape sweep (TTK dyn_perf_us, 2026-06-10): N=1024..1M, measured-minus-body intercept ≈1.5-1.77us, min measured 1.669us; 1.6 ≤ min so max(body,1.6) stays a valid lower bound. Used as a FLOOR (max), not additive.

gm_bandwidth_measured.source: membw-bench (pure DataCopyPad GM<->UB, 64 cores, fp32, min over 50 reps) on 950PR_9589, 2026-06-08. See tests/onboard/kernels/membw/
gm_bandwidth_measured.hbm_sustained_note: working set >> L2 (>=256MB): read 1.51, write 1.50 TB/s. The variant peak gm_bandwidth_bytes_per_s (1.4-1.6e12) is this HBM-sustained value; it is NOT too low.
gm_bandwidth_measured.l2_assisted_note: working set within L2 → effective GM BW 3.0-3.7 TB/s (data L2-resident). 单流(纯读/纯写)驻留拐点 ~128MB(=9589 L2 容量); copy(R+W 两份)per-tensor 拐点 ~56-64MB(=容量/2)。
gm_bandwidth_measured.l2_capacity_note: L2 容量模型地基(membw 单流扫描 2026-06-29, 读写对称证实 9589 L2=128MiB): 单流访问量 ≤128MB → L2 裸带宽(read ~4.5 / write ~4.95 TB/s, 数据驻 L2 不刷 HBM); 160MB 拐点(read 2.05 / write 1.77)、溢出退 HBM(~1.6)。模型: eff_bw = L2_read/L2_write if 单流访问量 ≤ l2_residency_knee else HBM。copy 等多份并存时有效容量 = 128MB/同时份数。
gm_bandwidth_measured.rw_contention_note: read and write contend on HBM: copy(32MB each way)=18.28us vs max(read,write)=14.19us => combined GM time ~= max(mte2,mte3) + 0.3*min(mte2,mte3). max_pipe (mte2||mte3 fully overlapped) over-optimistic for read+write streaming; this drives the softmax under-prediction, not a low peak BW.
gm_bandwidth_measured.fixed_overhead_note: host wall-time floor (<8MB are launch/sync bound, not BW bound)

gm_bandwidth_l2_aware.source: 2026-06-11 bench-device-03 <<<>>> mem_copy sweep (tests/calibration/bench_results/membw_copy_sweep.csv). copy_bw=combined(read+write)有效带宽 vs HBM流量工作集；已含读写争用。
gm_bandwidth_l2_aware.note: curve: 工作集(HBM-streamed bytes)→ 有效 copy 带宽。≤128MB 驻 L2(~2.84TB/s)，≥256MB 落 HBM(~1.45TB/s，取快侧以保证理论是有效下界)，中间线性插值。重复 copy_in 的张量(gm_reread_bytes)按 L2 读、与 HBM 流重叠，不计入。

memory_capacity_bytes.l2_source: 9589 L2 = 128MiB (134217728). 上板实测(kernels/membw --mode write, 2026-06-29 bench-device-03): 纯写 ≤128MB 满速 ~4.95-4.98 TB/s(L2 速)、160MB 骤降 1.77、≥192MB HBM 1.57 → 写有效 L2 驻留拐点在 (128,160]MB,9589 L2≥128MB。注:957b variant 记 112MiB,可能是不同 SKU；曾据'112MB'误改 112,被纯写实测证伪、已回退。copy(R+W 两份)per-tensor 拐点 ~56-64MB 是占两份所致,与 128MB 单流容量不矛盾。

usage_notes.pure_vector_active_cores: Use variants.*.core_counts.vector_core as max blockDim for pure Vector kernels.
usage_notes.gm_bandwidth_choice: Use variants.*.peak.gm_bandwidth_bytes_per_s for chip-level roofline; use derived_from_ini.vector_core_ddr_bandwidth_bytes_per_s for conservative vector-core-only MTE modeling.
usage_notes.l2_bandwidth_choice: Use variants.*.peak.l2_bandwidth_bytes_per_s when the generated evaluator models L2 hits; this is derived from INI rate fields and should be treated as a modeling default, not an externally guaranteed spec.
usage_notes.vector_ops_choice: Use variants.*.peak.vector_fp16_ops_per_s for FP16 vector FMA-like operations under RegBase dual issue. For instructions that cannot dual issue or are not FP16 FMA-like, the evaluator should apply an instruction-specific efficiency factor.
